newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Germany's Sonopress to open CD plant in S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Sonopress to open CD plant in S.Africa.

text.p: German compact disc (CD) manufacturer Sonopress said on Wednesday that it would set up a plant in South Africa which would be commissioned in 1997 to expand its global services.
The plant will manufacture CDs and CD-ROMs and will follow its sister company BMG Records, which has been in South Africa since 1992.
"Sonopress, one of the world's leading compact disc manufacturers, is setting up a plant in Johannesburg in order to expand its global services," the company said in a statement.
Sonopress is a unit of BMG Entertainment which is owned by Bertelsmann, one of the world's largest media groups.
Sonopress would compete in South Africa with Compact Disc Technologies (Pty) Ltd (CDT) which is jointly owned by EMI, Polygram, CNA Gallo and Tusk, the company said.
CDT controls between 65 and 70 percent of the South African record market, it said.
